children: GF Securities cut its price target on Dell Technologies

to $341 from $497 ahead of its Nov. 24 earnings report. The firm expects strong AI server shipments to lift quarterly earnings above Wall Street estimates, but sees weaker demand for traditional servers and PCs weighing on the business beyond this fiscal year. Dell shares rose 1.8% in Tuesday premarket trading.

GF projects fiscal third-quarter revenue of $54 billion and earnings of $7.18 per share, above the $6.50 consensus cited by Seeking Alpha. It also expects an 18.4% gross margin, below the 19.2% consensus.
The firm sees AI server sales reaching $85 billion this fiscal year, helping push annual revenue above $200 billion and potentially prompting Dell to raise guidance again.
The longer-term picture drove the more cautious outlook. GF raised its fiscal 2027 EPS estimate by 2% and lowered its fiscal 2028 estimate by 3%.

It expects traditional server shipments to fall again next fiscal year and PC shipments to decline by a high-single-digit percentage. The analysts also flagged Dell's loss of some of SpaceX's VR200 order to Hon Hai, better known as Foxconn.
The most revealing number on Nov. 24 may be gross margin. GF's forecast shows how Dell could beat earnings estimates even if it keeps less of each sales dollar than analysts expect.
The question for next year is whether AI server growth can offset weaker demand for conventional hardware, especially if customers already brought some of those purchases forward.

title: GF Securities Revamps Dell Target Ahead of Earnings
